prompt: A very slight push-in on the hatch. The man lets go and the woman lifts the white house out alone, holding it up to her face as if inspecting it, both of them laughing harder. He leans in and taps its red roof with a finger; she turns to him and they share a delighted look. Their crouched positions barely change.
